thresholds.source: Espressif ESP32-S3 datasheet (recommended VDD 3.0-3.6V, VIH=0.75*VDD, VIL=0.25*VDD): https://documentation.espressif.com/esp32-s3_datasheet_en.html

thresholds.limit: <= 100 mV p-p (design rule for analog/OLED rails)
thresholds.source: project design rule + HX711 PSRR 100 dB (datasheet); not a vendor spec

notes: Behavioural LDO = ideal 3.3 V behind 0.2 ohm + 11 uF; real LDO loop bandwidth/damping is not modelled, so this is a LOWER BOUND on droop. 100 mA BLE pulse is an ASSUMPTION (ESP32-S3 radio peaks can be higher; Wi-Fi TX peak ~355 mA). Verify on hardware with a scope.
